mapper.sql: SELECT p.id price_id, p.version, p.customer_id, p.sku_id, p.unit_price, p.effective_from, p.effective_to, p.updated_at, d.customer_code customer_code, d.name customer_name, s.sku_code, s.spec_name, s.spec_values, sp.name product_name FROM customer_agreement_price p LEFT JOIN customer d ON d.id = p.customer_id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = p.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu sp ON sp.id = s.spu_id
mapper.select: WHERE p.id= #{id} AND p . deleted = FALSE
SELECT id FROM customer WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT count(*) FROM customer_agreement_price WHERE customer_id=#{dimension} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND deleted=FALSE AND effective_from < COALESCE(#{to,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE},'infinity'::timestamptz) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{from,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}) AND id != #{excludeId}

SELECT id,customer_id,sku_id,unit_price,effective_from,effective_to,version,deleted FROM customer_agreement_price WHERE deleted=FALSE AND customer_id=#{dimension} AND effective_from <= #{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{at}) AND sku_id IN #{sku} ORDER BY effective_from DESC,id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_agreement_price_operation_log(agreement_price_id, operation_type, operator, before_data, after_data, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{operation}, #{operator}, CAST(#{before,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{operator})
